name: Grace of the Fey
body:
Fey blood makes you swift and graceful, providing you an unnatural combat sense with fey weapons.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 15, Cha 15, 1st-level druid

Benefit: You are proficient with the longsword or rapier as well as the short bow, longbow, short composite bow, and long composite bow. If you are already proficient with these weapons you gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls with them.

Special: This feat can only be chosen at 1st level.
